## Claims
- [source-backed] RWY Theorem 4.8 works integrally in \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and gives two Schur generating families for \(J_v\), with \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\) and \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 864-892]
- [source-backed] RWY uses the vertical-strip Pieri rule \(e_k s_\lambda=\sum_\mu s_\mu\) and an induction with three shape-reduction steps to prove generation; the cited argument does not state Smith forms or determinantal-divisor certificates. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 1009-1041; 1068-1142]
- [source-backed] St. Dizier–Yong prove minimality of the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) in \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), under \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-235]
- [source-backed] Their proof reformulates possible syzygies using Littlewood–Richardson coefficient linear systems and a terminating coproduct-tensor reduction algorithm for valid \((n,r,i,j,a,b,N)\); it is not stated as a degreewise Pieri-matrix Smith-form or unimodular-minor procedure. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 294-340; 494-516; 598-632]

## Strategy
Compared the current integral Schur-interval/Pieri-matrix objects with the two inspected full texts. RWY matches the coefficient ring, quotient \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), Schur generators, and Pieri background. St. Dizier–Yong matches the lower-family minimality target but uses LR-equation and Hopf-algebra reductions rather than degreewise integer presentation matrices.

## Gaps
The requested target—an external theorem or literature reduction supplying Smith forms, determinantal divisors, unimodular complementary minors, or a Pieri-matrix certificate for the current objects—was **not established**. The inspected sources provide adjacent generation/minimality results only. This is a bounded negative result for RWY (2011) and St. Dizier–Yong (2024), not a claim about all literature.

## Next
An internal derivation of the required integral Pieri matrices and their Smith or unimodular-minor certificates remains necessary.
